objective: Compile the services-led, provider-paid Lumyn v3 plan for consumer-local hybrid migration execution while keeping all runtime dispatch paused.
system_model_summary: The provider campaign plane supplies confirmed declarative migration intent and commercial scope. The consumer execution plane owns repository, model-data, command, credential, delivery, and merge authority. The bounded model plane is explicit and cannot self-approve or self-verify.
proven_findings: The Go CLI, result envelope, init/check commands, schemas, and OpenAPI/docs intake have direct retained evidence.
Several recognized runtime commands are not implemented and may still return a generic pass until M0 closes.
The bounded agent, migration engine, verification ladder, local export, optional draft PR, and paid campaign runtime are not implemented.
The external v2 Factory profile profiles/lumyn.yaml still represents the deterministic/PKI/receipt direction.
factoryd has not been qualified against v3 bounded-model, product-action, evidence, or closure semantics.

resolved.decision: Use a services-led, provider-paid campaign with consumer-local deterministic and bounded agent execution.
A signed declarative provider packet is authoritative when supplied and confirmed, but remains data and grants no code authority.
Use deterministic verification independent from generation and local export of evidence, patch, optional branch, PR bundle, and optional draft PR.

blocking: external Factory profile still encodes v2
factoryd v3 runtime qualification is absent

assumptions: Exactly 49 acceptance items and the authored M0-M10 graph are frozen.

unknowns: Exact external Factory profile change and version.

factory_compatibility.unblock_rule: No task dispatch until the external profile is updated and factoryd is qualified against the exact v3 control generation.

unblock_dependencies: Update external Factory profiles/lumyn.yaml to the approved v3 services-led hybrid contract.
Qualify factoryd against this exact v3 task, authority, bounded-model, evidence, and closure generation.
Re-run repo-pack self-test, repo-pack validation, and the full repository pre-push gate after both external dependencies are recorded.
factoryd_runtime.approval_posture: Factory approval never substitutes for exact private Lumyn product action authorization or human merge.
factoryd_runtime.credential_posture: no ambient consumer, provider, model, sandbox, or GitHub secrets
factoryd_runtime.network_posture: offline by default; exact task-scoped endpoints only

release_freeze.reason: Lumyn v3 Factory profile and factoryd runtime are not qualified.

runtime_pins.toolchain_version: go1.26.5; exact Node, npm, registry-or-snapshot, package-integrity, and toolchain pins before package-lock mutation
runtime_pins.dependency_policy: standard library first; pinned Go modules, parser runtime, model adapter, or tool dependency only with task evidence and license review
runtime_pins.distribution_target: explicitly licensed and integrity-signed design-partner binary or source package for consumer-local or consumer-controlled CI execution; public OSS, self-serve, and Homebrew require a separate approved gate
runtime_pins.provider_intent_policy: services-led provider-paid API or SDK sunset campaign with provider-confirmed source and target semantics; a signed declarative provider packet is authoritative when supplied and confirmed, remains data, cannot execute code, and grants no consumer repository authority; mandatory packet PKI, continuous status, connection receipts, and receipt-backed billing are deferred
runtime_pins.model_policy: bounded agent use requires exact model provider, endpoint, model and version, parameters, prompt and tool digests, selected context and request-disclosure classes, retention and regional posture, credential environment and scopes, network endpoint and operations, read and write paths, file, line, diff, turn, token, time, retry, concurrency, attempt, and cost budgets, plus request, response, tool-call, usage, and patch provenance; repository, provider, tool, and model content is untrusted and cannot widen any boundary
runtime_pins.verification_policy: deterministic repository and workflow verification is independent from deterministic or agent-assisted generation, runs from the exact candidate head, preserves baseline failures, and cannot be satisfied by a model completion or self-verification
runtime_pins.delivery_policy: complete local evidence plus patch, optional local branch, and PR-ready bundle is the baseline; optional remote branch and draft PR require separate exact authorization; default-branch writes and auto-merge are forbidden
runtime_pins.artifact_namespace: .factory/artifacts contains source-safe Factory controls and separately consented aggregate or digest evidence only; consumer-private code, prompts, responses, patches, traces, credentials, and identifiable campaign evidence use an approved external private root
runtime_pins.live_work_policy: Factory worker capabilities are only approval, credentials, and network and never substitute for Lumyn product action scopes; model disclosure, model network, model credential, repository, command, registry, sandbox, GitHub, reporting, retention, and deletion actions are separate, expiring, revocable, fail-closed product grants
runtime_pins.dispatch_policy: factoryd dispatch is paused and fail-closed until the external profiles/lumyn.yaml contract is updated for v3 and factoryd is qualified against this regenerated task, authority, model, evidence, and closure generation
